# GreenBean Coffee — Your Daily Coffee Ritual

## Overview

Build a 5-page corporate website for GreenBean Coffee, a premium coffeehouse chain. The site should feel like walking into a warm, well-designed coffee shop — inviting, modern, and just a touch playful. The audience spans everyday coffee lovers, loyalty members, gift card shoppers, and casual browsers. The primary goals are driving online ordering, showcasing seasonal drinks, growing the rewards program, and making gift card purchases effortless.

## Visual Direction

Think earthy greens, warm creams, and rich coffee browns. Use a clean sans-serif typeface (like Inter or DM Sans) for body text, paired with a slightly more expressive heading font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners, and soft shadows should give the site a friendly, approachable feel. Photography placeholders should suggest lifestyle coffee imagery — hands wrapped around mugs, latte art, cozy café interiors. Keep the layout modern and airy, never cluttered.

## Key Priorities

- **Home page impact**: The hero and seasonal drink highlights are the first impression — they should feel vibrant and immediately actionable with clear ordering CTAs.
- **Rewards redemption tabs**: The tabbed star-level redemption display (25 through 400 Stars) is a core interactive element. Make the tab switching feel smooth and the content instantly clear — this is what convinces people to join.
- **Gift card carousels**: Both the featured and category-specific carousels need polished next/previous navigation. Six occasion categories should be easy to browse without overwhelming the page.
- **Store locator interactivity**: The search, filter toggle, and pickup/delivery switching should all feel responsive and functional, even with placeholder data.
- **Menu organization**: The sidebar + category layout must be intuitive. Users should quickly scan across drinks, food, and at-home coffee sections.
- **Responsive design** is required across all pages — pay special attention to the footer accordion behavior on mobile.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

arguments.description: Build menu.html page
arguments.prompt:
Create the file `/app/output/menu.html` — the Menu page for GreenBean Coffee.

## Design System
- Uses `/app/output/styles.css` and `/app/output/app.js`
- Brand colors: #00824A (primary green), #32462F (dark forest), #F3CEA1 (warm cream), #6B4226 (coffee brown)
- Fonts: DM Serif Display for headings, Inter for body (loaded in styles.css)
- Tailwind CSS CDN: `<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>` with custom config
- Tone: warm, modern, playful

## Tailwind Config
```html
<script>
tailwind.config = {
  theme: {
    extend: {
      colors: {
        'gb-green': '#00824A',
        'gb-green-dark': '#006838',
        'gb-forest': '#32462F',
        'gb-cream': '#F3CEA1',
        'gb-cream-light': '#FFF8EE',
        'gb-coffee': '#6B4226',
        'gb-coffee-light': '#8B5E3C',
        'gb-warm': '#FFFBF5',
      },
      fontFamily: {
        'serif-display': ['DM Serif Display', 'Georgia', 'serif'],
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>
```

## Page Sections (in order)

1. **Header** — Same as other pages (fixed, white bg):
   - Logo: green circle with "G" + "GreenBean" text (link to index.html)
   - Desktop nav: Menu (menu.html, active), Rewards (rewards.html), Gift Cards (gift.html) — Menu link has .active class
   - Right: "Find a store" link (store-locator.html), "Sign in", "Join now" green pill
   - Mobile: hamburger + #mobile-nav

2. **Breadcrumb** (below header, pt-20):
   - Home > Menu

3. **Page Title**: "Menu" (DM Serif Display, large)

4. **Main Content** — Two-column layout (sidebar + content):
   
   **Left Sidebar** (sticky, ~240px wide, hidden on mobile as a horizontal scroll bar):
   - **The Latest**: Trending, Citrus Energy Refreshers
   - **Drinks**: Protein Beverages, Hot Coffee, Cold Coffee, Matcha, Hot Tea, Cold Tea, Refreshers, Frappuccino® Blended Beverage, Hot Chocolate/Lemonade & More, Bottled Beverages
   - **Food**: Breakfast, Bakery, Treats, Lunch, Lite Bites
   - **At Home Coffee**: Whole Bean, GreenBean VIA® Instant, Shopping Bag
   - Each section has a .sidebar-heading and links with .menu-sidebar styles
   - "Hot Coffee" is active by default

   **Right Content** (flex-1):
   
   a. **Drinks Section** (id="drinks"):
      - Sub-section "Hot Coffee": 4 item cards in a grid (2 cols md, 3 cols lg)
        - Caffè Americano, Caffè Latte, Cappuccino, Caramel Macchiato
        - Each card: image placeholder on top, name below, brief description
      - Sub-section "Cold Coffee": 4 items
        - Iced Caffè Americano, Iced Caffè Latte, Cold Brew, Nitro Cold Brew
   
   b. **Food Section** (id="food"):
      - Sub-section "Breakfast": 3 items (Bacon Gouda Sandwich, Spinach Wrap, Oatmeal)
      - Sub-section "Bakery": 3 items (Butter Croissant, Chocolate Croissant, Blueberry Muffin)
   
   c. **At Home Coffee Section** (id="at-home"):
      - 3 items (Whole Bean Colombia, VIA Instant, Shopping Bag)
   
   Each menu item card: rounded-xl, white bg, subtle border, hover lift. Image placeholder (gradient bg ~120px tall), item name (font-semibold), 1-line description (text-sm text-gray-500), calories info (text-xs text-gray-400).

5. **Footer** — Same as home page (bg-gb-forest, 5 columns with accordion on mobile):
   - About Us, Careers, Social Impact, For Business Partners, Order and Pick Up columns
   - About Us: Our Company, Our Coffee, About GreenBean, GreenBean Archive, Investor Relations, Customer Service, Contact Us
   - Careers: Culture and Values, Belonging at GreenBean, College Achievement Plan, Alumni Community, U.S. Careers, International Careers
   - Social Impact: Communities, GreenBean Foundation, Sustainability, Environmental and Social Impact Reporting
   - For Business Partners: Landlord Support Center, Suppliers, Corporate Gift Card Sales, Office and Foodservice Coffee
   - Order and Pick Up: Order on the App, Order on the Web, Delivery, Order and Pick Up Options, Explore and Find Coffee for Home
   - Bottom: copyright

## Mobile Layout
- On mobile (<768px): sidebar becomes a horizontal scrollable bar at the top of the content area
- Menu items in single column on mobile, 2 cols on md, 3 cols on lg

## Requirements
- Responsive design
- Include app.js at end of body
- All links work between pages (relative paths)
- Max width: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
- Image placeholders use gradient backgrounds with coffee-themed SVG icons

Write the complete HTML file to `/app/output/menu.html`.

2. **Rewards Hero** (bg-gb-cream-light, pt-24):
   - Large centered heading: "GreenBean® Rewards" (DM Serif Display, ~4xl-5xl)
   - Subheading: "Join for free and start earning Stars toward free drinks and treats."
   - Two buttons: "Join now" (btn-primary) + "Sign in" (btn-secondary)
   - Decorative star icons scattered

3. **How It Works** (bg-white, py-16):
   - Section title: "Getting started is easy"
   - 3 steps in a row (flex/grid):
     1. **Collect Stars** — Number circle "1", "Earn Stars by making eligible purchases and participating in challenges, offers and games."
     2. **Enjoy free treats** — Number circle "2", "Redeem your Stars for free food, drinks and more. Look forward to a birthday treat on us every year."
     3. **Unlock benefits** — Number circle "3", "Keep earning Stars to increase your status and help you get to free faster. Discover more benefits at every level."
   - Each step: icon/number at top, title (font-semibold), description (text-gray-600)

4. **Status Tiers** (bg-gb-cream-light, py-16):
   - Section title: "Earn your way to more"
   - 3 tier cards side by side (responsive: stack on mobile):
   
   a. **Green** (tier-green bg, .tier-card class):
      - Badge: "GREEN" with green color
      - Star threshold: "Less than 500 ★ per year"
      - Benefits list (with check icons):
        - Free birthday treat
        - Earn 1 ★ per $1
        - Free Mod Mondays
        - Double Stars with personal cup
   
   b. **Gold** (tier-gold bg, .tier-card class):
      - Badge: "GOLD" with gold/amber color
      - Star threshold: "500+ ★ per year"
      - Benefits list:
        - 7-day birthday window
        - Earn 1.2 ★ per $1
        - Stars won't expire
        - 4 extra Double Star Days
   
   c. **Reserve** (tier-reserve bg, .tier-card class):
      - Badge: "RESERVE" with deep rose/plum color
      - Star threshold: "2,500+ ★ per year"
      - Benefits list:
        - 30-day birthday window
        - Earn 1.7 ★ per $1
        - Exclusive global coffee experiences
        - Free personalized Reserve Card
        - 6 extra Double Star Days

5. **Redemption Levels** (bg-white, py-16) — **CRITICAL INTERACTIVE SECTION**:
   - Section title: "Redeem your Stars"
   - Tab bar (id="redemption-tabs", .tab-list class) with 6 tabs:
     - "25 ★" (active by default)
     - "60 ★"
     - "100 ★"
     - "200 ★"
     - "300 ★"
     - "400 ★"
   - Each tab has data-tab="25", data-tab="60", etc.
   - Tab content panels (id="redemption-tabs" container, .tab-content with data-tab-content):
     - 25 ★: "$1 off a drink customization (espresso shot, syrup, or cold foam)" — value "Up to $1"
     - 60 ★: "Up to $2 off your order" — value "Up to $2"
     - 100 ★: "Brewed coffee or tea, bakery item, packaged snacks and more" — value "Up to $6"
     - 200 ★: "Handcrafted drink or hot breakfast" — value "Up to $10"
     - 300 ★: "Sandwich, protein box or packaged coffee" — value "Up to $16"
     - 400 ★: "Select GreenBean merchandise" — value "Up to $20"
   - Each tab content shows: star count prominently, reward description, value, and a placeholder image area

   - Section title: "Partnerships that take you further"
   - Two partnership cards side by side:
     - **Delta**: "Link your Delta account to earn miles, Bonus Stars and access exclusive offers."
     - **Marriott Bonvoy**: "Link your Marriott Bonvoy account to earn points, Bonus Stars and access exciting member experiences."
   - Each card: logo placeholder, description, "Learn more" link

7. **App Download** (bg-gb-forest, text-white, py-16):
   - Centered
